evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Contains a clear role (moderator) and a requested functionality (create a new game).

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Contains a clear role (moderator) and functionality (invite estimators via URL).

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Contains a clear role and functionality (start a round by entering an item).

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Role present and functionality identifiable (see all items for the session).

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Role and requested functionality (select an item) are explicit.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (add an item) are present despite minor duplication in text.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Clear role and functionality (edit an item) identified.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (delete an item) are explicit.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Contains role and requested functionality (show all estimates immediately).

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Role present and functionality (accept average) clearly stated.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (auto-fill estimate field under condition) are identifiable.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Clear role and functionality (enter agreed estimate).

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (re-estimate a prior story) are explicit.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Contains role and clear functionality (import stories).

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (copy/paste stories) are identifiable.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (browse previous games) present.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Role and requested functionality (view transcript) are clear.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (export transcript as HTML) explicit.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (export as CSV) are identifiable.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Contains role and functionality (delete a game).

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to create an account for the application by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Role and clear functionality (create an account with credentials) present.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (log in) are explicit.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Role and requested functionality (change account details) clear.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Role present and functionality (delete account) identifiable.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (show dates/times in local timezone) are explicit.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Contains role and functionality (receive password reminder via email).

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (select estimation scale) identifiable despite placeholder values.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (limit invites to 15) are explicit.

evaluations.evidence: As an estimator, I want to join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (join a game by entering name) clear.

evaluations.evidence: As an estimator, I want to see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (see the item) are explicit.

evaluations.evidence: As an estimator, I want to see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (see all items) identified.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Role and requested functionality (immediately see who has given an estimate) are clear.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (show all estimates simultaneously after all have voted) present.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (change estimate until draw completes) are explicit.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to be able to see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (see prior estimates) clearly stated.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (see who gave which estimates) identifiable.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (start a visible two-minute timer) are explicit despite minor grammar issue.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (auto-reset timer) present.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (scroll through prior rounds) are clear.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (consistent card order) identifiable.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (change estimate before draw completion) clear.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Role and requested functionality (display thumbnail photo) are explicit.

evaluations.evidence: As a developer, I want to have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (site compliant with standards) identifiable.

evaluations.evidence: As a developer, I want to have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (provide a list of definitions) are explicit.

evaluations.evidence: As a developer, I want to have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (create database indexes) present.

evaluations.evidence: As a developer, I want to have the application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (application functions correctly in specified browsers) are explicit.

evaluations.evidence: As a developer, I want to have the site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (site comply with accessibility guidelines) identifiable.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Role and requested functionality (application responds quickly) are clear.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (support Unicode) are explicit.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (sensible/predictable URLs) identifiable.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (nice error pages) are clear.

evaluations.evidence: As a Researcher, I want results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Role and functionality (store results non-identifiably) are explicit.

evaluations.evidence: As a Mike, I want to be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Although 'Mike' is a specific name, it functions as a stakeholder role and the functionality (see usage metrics) is clear.
